# PiTTy 1.2.8

## Cleaner tool input and output

- Replace competing `view input` and `expand` links with one right-aligned `details` control on each tool row.
- Keep the full tool name, elapsed time, and detail control readable on narrow terminals. Long command arguments shrink first.
- Show output as one quiet `↳` preview when collapsed. Open `details` to see the original input and the full labeled output without duplicated controls.
- Do not add a second row for successful commands that returned `(no output)`.
- Size expanded output to its actual line count and wrapping instead of allocating at least six rows for short results. Large outputs stay bounded and scrollable.
- Preserve transcript-first mouse scrolling, explicit output scrolling, global tool detail toggles, and Mermaid output rendering.
- Cover 76, 94, and 126-column layouts, short and long results, missing output, and expand/collapse interactions with render tests.

The running session, credentials, models, agent processes, and saved conversations are unchanged. The staged update activates on the next PiTTy launch.
